evaluations.description: Generate a fractions course in portable mode (no repo)
evaluations.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course about fractions for 8-10 year old students. Should have 3 lessons covering: 1) What fractions are, 2) Comparing fractions, 3) Adding fractions with like denominators.

checks: course-spec.json is valid JSON and parses successfully
each lesson has objectives, coreIdea, examples, misconceptions
each lesson has at least one activity

evaluations.description: Generate an intro JavaScript course in portable mode
evaluations.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course for complete beginners learning JavaScript. Cover variables, data types, and basic functions. Target adult learners with no prior programming. 4 lessons, 30 minutes each.

checks: each lesson has at least one exercise activity
lesson IDs are kebab-case and unique

evaluations.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course for learning basic French greetings and introductions. 2 lessons, for adult travelers. Include vocabulary, pronunciation, and practice activities.

checks: activities include reading and exercise types
course-brief states target audience as adult travelers

evaluations.description: Generate a complete compiled package inside the Open-Edu repo
evaluations.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course about the solar system for 10-12 year olds. 3 lessons. Generate the full package: compile, validate, and lint it. Output to ./course-output/.

checks: edu validate succeeds on the package
edu lint-content passes or reports only warnings

evaluations.description: Generate a course from a supplied PDF textbook chapter
evaluations.prompt: I have a PDF textbook at ./textbook.pdf covering basic algebra. Create a course spec for chapter 1 only. Use the pipeline with the math profile.

checks: pipeline is invoked with math profile
pipeline output (course-spec.md) is transformed to course-spec.json
pipeline artifacts (concept map, blueprint) are preserved

evaluations.description: Handle missing learner level by asking for clarification
evaluations.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course about photosynthesis. Make it good.
evaluations.expectedBehavior: ASYMMETRIC: Should ask follow-up questions about learner age/level, duration, and learning goals before generating. Should NOT assume defaults silently.

checks: agent asks clarifying questions before generating
agent does NOT produce course-spec.json without sufficient input
agent records assumptions when user doesn't specify

evaluations.description: Handle a request for an unsupported widget gracefully
evaluations.prompt: Create a course about music theory. Use a widget called 'open-edu.piano-simulator' for the practice activities.
evaluations.expectedBehavior: ASYMMETRIC: Should note that 'open-edu.piano-simulator' is not in the catalog and fall back to reading/exercise instead.

checks: generated spec does NOT include 'open-edu.piano-simulator' as a widgetId
quality report warns about unsupported widget request

evaluations.description: Handle existing output directory by asking before overwriting
evaluations.prompt: Create a fractions course. Output to an existing directory at ./course-output/ (which already has a previous course-spec.json).
evaluations.expectedBehavior: ASYMMETRIC: Should detect existing output and ask for confirmation before overwriting.

checks: agent asks for confirmation before overwriting
agent does NOT auto-overwrite without permission

evaluations.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course about basic arithmetic in Spanish (locale es-MX). For 6-8 year olds. 2 lessons.

checks: content is age-appropriate for 6-8 year olds
